subject: Unapplied e-invoice batch & VAT tag mismatch — action plan
messages:
From: Sara Connor <sara.connor@brightpeak.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: accounting@brightpeak.com
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00Z
Subject: Payment posted to wrong invoice IDs (e-invoice batch 20261001)

Hi Tessa,

We ran our October e-invoice batch on 2026-10-01 and the payment for Redwood invoice series RB-2026-10-0001 through RB-2026-10-0006 appears to have been applied to older invoice numbers on your side (RB-2025-09-xxxx range). Our AR team attached the remittance file and bank trace (brightpeak_remittance_10112026.csv) — payment trace id is BP-TR-778922.

We believe the issue is a change in your invoice ID mapping in the e-invoice feed (new trailing checksum appended on 2026-09-30). The amounts match the batch total and the VAT amount looks different after your application, which is causing a VAT tag mismatch for our tax filing. Could you confirm receipt and next steps to move the cash from the incorrectly credited invoices to the correct ones?

We need this fixed before BrightPeak files its VAT return next week (EU filing window). Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sara Connor
Billing Lead 
BrightPeak Analytics

Attachment: brightpeak_remittance_10112026.csv (csv, 1.2KB)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Sara Connor <sara.connor@brightpeak.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T10:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment posted to wrong invoice IDs (e-invoice batch 20261001)

Sara — thanks for flagging and for the remittance. I've looped in Lauren and Marcus from Finance to triage.

High level we will:
- Confirm the cash trace against our bank file and open a suspense (suspense_AR) entry for the incorrectly applied amount.
- Reverse the stale AR application and reapply to RB-2026-10-0001..0006.
- Ensure VAT tagging aligns with original invoices so your VAT reporting is unaffected.

Marcus / Lauren — can you take the lead on proposing the journal entries and ETA? We may also need a 3rd-party settlement trace (Stripe/Bank) to confirm the original payment posting. Sara shared BP-TR-778922.

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, Sara Connor <sara.connor@brightpeak.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment posted to wrong invoice IDs (e-invoice batch 20261001)

Sara / team — I reviewed the remittance against our AR ledger for the date window and see ~€142,300 posted on 2026-10-01 that was applied to invoices in the 2025 cohort. Marcus, please see my notes below and confirm the journal approach.

Lauren's notes:
- Short term: Move cash from "AR - Incorrectly Applied" (4105) into "AR Suspense" (4199) with a reversing entry to clear the wrong invoice balances.
- Reapply from suspense to the correct RB-2026 invoices once we have positive match keys (invoice number + net amount + VAT).
- VAT treatment: Because some of these invoices are EU B2B with reverse-charge and some standard VAT, we must preserve original VAT codes when reapplying.

Requests to BrightPeak:
1) Please attach a bank statement excerpt showing BP-TR-778922 or provide Stripe/Acquirer trace id.
2) Confirm whether the remittance file includes any transformed invoice numbers (your system mapping) — any mapping table is helpful.

Estimate: We can prepare the reversing journal and suspense transfer by end-of-day 2026-10-12 if we have the bank trace. Final reapplication and VAT tag correction early 2026-10-14.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance — Revenue Accounting
Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, Sara Connor <sara.connor@brightpeak.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment posted to wrong invoice IDs (e-invoice batch 20261001)

Adding the preliminary journal lines and attaching the suspect cash application CSV (cash_application_suspects_1012.csv). Attachment includes AR record ids our system applied the cash to.

Proposed journals (draft):
1) Reverse incorrect application (to clear wrong invoice balances):
   Dr AR - Incorrectly Applied (4105)  €142,300
   Cr Bank Suspense (4199)      €142,300
   (Memo: reverse mis-application from RB-2025 cohort per BP-TR-778922)

2) Reapply to correct invoices from suspense (post verification):
   Dr Bank Suspense (4199)      €142,300
   Cr AR - RB-2026-10 (4001)     €142,300
   (Preserve original VAT codes per invoice metadata)

VAT handling note: Several lines show VAT code mismatch because when the e-invoice parser appended the checksum the VAT tag lookup failed and defaulted to "STANDARD_EU". We must map VAT codes back using invoice metadata (tax_code field) prior to reapplication to prevent revenue recognition variance.

I will prepare reversal JEs in the staging ledger and queue for approval. Need bank snippet (requested) and a short confirmation from BrightPeak that BP-TR-778922 should tie to the RB-2026 invoices; a one-line confirmation is sufficient to avoid additional investigations.

Attachment: cash_application_suspects_1012.csv (csv, 3.4KB)

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Sara Connor <sara.connor@brightpeak.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T11:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment posted to wrong invoice IDs (e-invoice batch 20261001)

Sara — following up so we can meet Lauren's timeline. Two quick asks:
1) Can you paste the original invoice identifiers as produced by your e-invoice system (the file you sent looked to have a mapping column with the older id).
2) Please upload a bank statement snippet (PDF) showing BP-TR-778922 (or confirm the Stripe settlement id if processed through Stripe).

We will:
- Schedule the reversal in the staging ledger on 2026-10-12 EOD and reapply on 2026-10-14 after you confirm mapping.
- Send a short note to your tax team once VAT tags are preserved.

If you prefer a 15-minute call today, I can book Marcus and Lauren.

Thanks,
Tessa

From: Sara Connor <sara.connor@brightpeak.com>
